layout.notebook_first:
Everything you add, the singularity will erase. Only this remains.
Carry the circuit board. It breaks the first loop.

notes.text: The gyroscope only shows up for someone carrying the circuit board.
You won't find the gyroscope unless you carry the circuit board. Don't ask me how I know.
The gyroscope only shows up for someone carrying the circuit board.
The duct tape only shows up for someone carrying the gyroscope.
Looked everywhere for the voice recorder. It was never there until I picked up the gyroscope and the duct tape.
The voice recorder with the fuse, and nothing else that matters. That door hurts.
The voice recorder only shows up for someone carrying the gyroscope and the duct tape.
Carried the snow globe through a dozen doors. Nothing changed. Drop it.
Engines. The gyroscope, the duct tape, the voice recorder. Nothing else but this notebook. Drop the circuit board when the time comes.
I walked these rooms for hours before I got it. Carry the voice recorder and the doors let you go.
The engine room answers to three things: the gyroscope, the duct tape and the voice recorder. Keep the notebook. The circuit board has done its job. Let it go.
The engines are humming. Now remember how you got to the bridge.
Tried the circuit board together with the duct tape. Bad room. Don't.
Carried the snow globe through a dozen doors. Nothing changed. Drop it.
